args.body: If CATALOGUE-INQUIRY-COMPLETENESS-CONTROL remains open, use the committed catalogue-google-group-id-delivery/adapted-run.json and example-and-reply-en-fr.md alongside the saved public template and prior rehearsal. Map supplied family labels and offer IDs explicitly to the checker headers before testing. Use the existing mission to establish whether the public instructions elicit the required fields and stage a minimal bilingual correction only if the control shows a missing instruction. Reuse any completed result. No external contact or public release.

description: Completed the catalogue variant group ID mission. The first run rejected both CSV headers. After mapping the columns to the unchanged checker’s expected format, the consistent sample passed and a single changed ID produced the expected family conflict. The read-back evidence includes a bilingual, nonbinding reply for authorized inbound use. Google feed acceptance remains unverified and CAD 60 remains provisional. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown. Treasury is unfunded and verified revenue remains CAD 0. The independent search for an explicit paid buyer request continues.
